home: I am Chacha, a second-year Computer Science student majoring in Data Science at Monash University in Melbourne, Australia. I will be graduating in late November next year, as I am taking a 3-year undergraduate program.

I enjoy making small projects in my free time. One of them is creating websites for my friends as gifts, which lets me combine my creativity with technology. I also enjoy finding ways to apply coding and IT to everyday life, such as analysing my personal budget and calculating how to split expenses with others.

project.intro: I’m keen to learn new techniques and software introduced by influencers and studios, mostly through social media, and I often experiment with new features by building websites in my own time. I also use my own code and spreadsheets to track my grocery budget and to split costs when eating out or sharing with friends. These are all self-directed projects, taken on independently outside my university studies.

cards.title: UX & UI design
cards.text: I’m interested in the design side of IT. I’ve been teaching myself through Figma tutorials and experimenting with animation to improve the look and feel of websites.
